correctness.rationale: For m,n>=2, the LD-set predicate is reconstructed exactly: an LD-set omits at most one vertex per shore, and every such set is dominating. This gives gamma_L=m+n-2. Stars use the standard gamma_L=N-1 value stated in the initiating source. The three-block constructions are explicit. The four-block impossibility argument tracks complements of coalition unions and exhausts every possible partner of the two forced singleton remainder blocks. K2 has no LDC-partition because each singleton is already an LD-set. Exhaustive partition enumeration through total order nine independently matches the theorem.

value.rationale: Complete bipartite graphs are a canonical first test family for a new domination-coalition invariant. The classification is complete, includes the no-partition boundary K2, isolates K2,2 as the unique four-block exception, and explains why every larger biclique collapses to three. This is a natural structural classification rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
